summary.title: 72-hour chart and smoother zoom
changes: The home chart now shows up to 72 hours of history when opened.
Charts render only the visible time span plus padding to keep panning and zooming responsive.
You can pinch-zoom in to 1 hour, with smoother previews that snap to stable zoom steps.
When auto-following, the current glucose reading stays visible at tight zoom levels.
The Time in Range banner now shows 'today', and midnight x-axis ticks include day labels.
